title: Laptop overheating and slowing down
description: My device has been overheating for about a week, the temperature goes above 90°C. CPU usage is high even when idle.

worklogs.description: Monitored CPU temperature with HWiNFO, set the fan profile to 'Cool' in Dell PowerManager.
Created a service appointment, the thermal paste will be replaced.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The user is on a 3-year-old Latitude; periodic maintenance will be performed.
